Long Haul

उष्णकटिबंधीय वायु मार्ग

An airway or designated flight route that traverses tropical climate regions, often with unique meteorological and navigational considerations.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition

An airway or designated flight route that traverses tropical climate regions, often with unique meteorological and navigational considerations.

Operational example

We are filing via the tropical air route to avoid convective weather along the standard route.

Localized term
